L_base_provenance: 3.01799878914405 raw source miles * 1.609344; historical price-conditioned global reference
L_gg_prime: actual passenger origin-to-destination trip distance in km
epsilon_interpretation: positive distance-price behavioural adjustment parameter; not conventional signed elasticity
training_requirement: Separate launch authorization; frozen supported provider provenance and validation_only=False required
reward: Gross successfully assigned dispatch fare only; unmatched/rejected/no-offer contribution zero
planned_calibration_source: abs(authoritative Record-029 epsilon), only finite VALID supported positive rows from Jan1–Mar15, if real response labels unavailable
allowed_floor_candidates: Historical diagnostic only; no additional floor selected
protected_dates: March17–31 excluded from all V1 calibration, selection, tuning, training and hierarchical evaluation
passenger_features: epsilon/P_c enter mask only, not state
next_state: next chronological actionable request; skip no-offer requests while simulator time advances
timestamp_source: existing actual simulated request event timestamp: slot start + empirical_within_slot_offset_seconds, with existing mini-slot offset fallback
optimizer_cadence: exactly 8 updates per completed warm slot, otherwise 0

calibration_support.support_rule: Restrict Jan1–Mar15 VALID; epsilon_proxy_raw=abs(Record029 epsilon); exclude nonfinite and exact-zero; inclusive empirical P0.5–P99.5 on positive proxy; then additional floor candidates on supported population
calibration_support.global_reference_exception: P_base/L_base are explicit user-frozen constants; not recalibrated.
calibration_support.grouping: Global eligible positive pool; no new time-group selection
calibration_support.NO_FLOOR: No additional floor beyond V1 positive-support restriction

legacy_entrypoint: Preserved for provenance, not the V1 execution path; do not invoke old multiepisode slot update wrapper on V1.
Pc_field_interpretation: P_c_USD and v1_pc_usd now denote effective threshold; P_raw_c/v1_raw_pc_usd explicitly preserve equation value
empty_mask_interpretation: Defensive invariant/data-quality condition, not expected economic behavior
